objective: Test whether Spark/footer/history inputs predict decoded GPU scan bytes, and whether decoded bytes, rows, or both predict the local single-GPU performance knee.

queries.filtered: same projection with trip_distance [1,10) and passenger_count > 0
queries.schema_evolution: adds PULocationID, including epochs where it is absent and materialized null

boundaries.C_split: task input compressed bytes as recorded by Spark; actuator-facing
boundaries.R_projected: GPU scan output rows per task
boundaries.U_projected: sum of emitted GPU scan batch footprints per task
boundaries.U_projected_batch_max: largest emitted GPU scan batch footprint per task
boundaries.U_survive: sum of emitted GpuFilter batch footprints per task for filtered query

models.inputs: projected Parquet footer uncompressed column-chunk bytes

models.prediction: rows times fixed widths plus one validity bit per nullable column, rounded to the observed allocator boundary only when documented

models.inputs: footer rows/chunks/types/nulls plus 2009 measured per-column residual/variable-width history

models.validation: next episode; never same-query future data

primary_graphs: elapsed time and rows/s versus configured treatment
GPU decode throughput versus realized U_projected and R_projected
RMM/task peak and retry/spill versus realized U/R
performance_analysis.model_comparison: chronological prediction error and held-out rank/regret for bytes-only, rows-only, and combined byte+row performance models
performance_analysis.plateau: descriptive only: candidates within 5% of the best episode/query median; report all three block values and bootstrap interval without making a production recommendation
performance_analysis.selection: no production recommendation from three local repeats; identify knee hypotheses for a confirmatory run
performance_analysis.zero_survivors: retain as zero-output evidence; do not fit C/U_survive ratio
performance_analysis.memory_safety: observed no retry/spill/OOM is bounded test evidence; use RMM task peak upper quantile, not outputBatchBytes, for safety

abort_conditions: nonidentical result hashes within an episode/query
adjacent candidates produce identical scan task count and realized U/R distributions
failed task, retry, spill, OOM, or executor loss in the primary lane
limitations: OS cache cannot be fully cold-reset
100 ms GPU utilization sidecar omitted from this initial sweep
output footprint is not peak residency
